reason: Both emails make the same honest case: four years at $9,000, two books over 20,000 copies, a state reading list, a $12,500 fee elsewhere and the agent's range. Both ask warmly for $11,500. B's 'lower end of the range' framing and offer of a call are a little stronger, but its unfilled placeholders and unsupported 'full-time' claim offset that, so as the editor I'd respond to either the same way.
